'''Enrique Huerta Tatooine Final Confrontation 07-08-00 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Enrique Huerta]] posted on DeckTech on 16 July 2000 about [[2000 Tatooine Regionals]].<ref name="tr-d1011">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-tatooine-final-confrontation-07-08-00d1011/ tatooine-final-confrontation-07-08-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-tatooine-final-confrontation-07-08-00d1011/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Enrique Huerta's turn-by-turn account of the final confrontation of the 2000 Tatooine Regionals, in which Josh Martin beat Brett Kitani 2–0, winning game 1 by 13 Force and game 2 by 9.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Enrique Huerta]] (byline: Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta)
* '''Published:''' 16 July 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Tatooine Final Confrontation 07-08-00''
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Tatooine Regionals]]
* '''Event date:''' 8 July 2000

== Other results named in the report ==

* 1st: [[Josh Martin]]
* 2nd: [[Brett Kitani]]

== Original report ==

'''tatooine-final-confrontation-07-08-00'''
* '''Author:''' Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta
* '''Published:''' Jul 16, 2000

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  2000 Tatooine Regional

Final Confrontation



Enrique Huerta

Max Rebo of Tatooine





Game 1

Brett Kitani (LS) vs. Josh Martin (DS)



DS - Started with the Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber and Broken Conecentration

LS - Started with Hoth: Main Power Generations, Hoth: North Ridge and A New Secret Base



Turn 1

(DS):

JM - Deploy Audience Chamber, and Imperial Holotable. Scanning Crew x2 (Obi-Wan w/ and Luke w/).

(LS):

BK - Signal (Goo Nee Tay). Deploy Echo Base: War Room and Echo Base: Corridor.



Turn 2

(DS):

JM - Deploy Tatooine: Cantina, Scanning Crew x2 (Obi-Wan, Orrimarrko)

(LS):

JM - A Dangerous Time and Broken Concentration (during Control Phase)

BK - Draw up cards.



Turn 3

(DS):

JM - Monnok Lost (Obi-Wan x2, Han w/ x2) Deploy Monnok @ Imperial Holotable

(LS):

JM - A Dangerous Time (Control Phase)

BK - Deploy Twass Khaa, Bo Shek, R-3PO @ Cantina



Turn 4

(DS):

JM - Drain (1)

JM - Deploy Mara Jade and MJ's Lightsaber @ Cantina, Battle (Twass Khaa 'hit', 8-10) lose 2 Force.

BK - Forfeits Bo Shek.

(LS):

BK - R-3PO does 1 Force damage (Control Phase)

JM - A Dangerous Time (Control Phase)

BK - Draw up cards



Turn 5

(DS):

JM - Drain (4), Scanning Crew x2 (Leia w/, Wedge Antilles), Monnok Lost (from Holotable) for 6 cards.

JM - Deploy Mii'yonith @ JP: Audience Chamber

(LS):

BK - R-3PO (1)

BK - Deploy Mantillian Savrip



Turn 6

(DS):

JM - Drain (4)

JM - Deploy Cloud City: Port Town District, Scanning Crew (Luke w/)

(LS):

BK - R-3PO (1)

JM - A Dangerous Time (Control Phase)

BK - Deploy Leia w/ @ AC. Jerome Webb, Momar Nadon @ Cantina

BK - Battle @ AC (4-1)

JM -  Forfeit Mii'yonith

BK - Battle @ Cantina (9-5)

JM - Forfeit Mara Jade



Turn 7

(DS):

JM - Deploy DarthVader, Dark Lord of the Sith @ Cantina, Deploy Hoth: Ice Plains

JM - Battle @ Cantina (Jerome Webb 'choke', 11- 3)

BK - Forfeit R-3PO, Momar Nadon, Millennium Falcon (Savrip)

(LS):

BK - Drain (2)

BK - Deploy Dagobah: Yoda's Hut



Turn 8

(DS):

JM - Drain (2)

JM - Deploy Mara Jade @ AC

JM - Battle @ AC (7-4)

BK - Forfeit Spiral (Savrip)

JM - Scanning Screw

BK - Sense

JM - Scanning Crew

BK - Sense

JM - Scanning Crew [Sorry, I missed what was sent to the Used Pile.]

(LS):

BK - Battle @ AC (7-5) Forfeit Leia w/ [I'm not sure why Leia was lost, the destiny was a 0.]

JM - Forfeit Mara Jade



Turn 9

(DS):

JM - Drain (2)

JM - Deploy Chief Retwin @ CC: PTD, Scanning Crew (Leia w/)

(LS):

BK - Deploy Lando w/ @ CC: PTD

BK - Battle @ CC:PTD (shoot, miss, Retwin 'hides')



Turn 10

(DS):

JM - Drain (2)

JM - Deploy Grand Moff Tarkin @ Cantina, Scanning Crew (Orrimarrko)

BK - Shocking Information

JM - Loses Scanning Crew and 4 Force

(LS):

BK - Deploy Luke w/ @ Cantina

JM - Elis Helrot Chief Retwin to AC.



Turn 11

(DS):

JM - Drain (1)

JM - Deploy Brangus Glee @ CC: PTD

JM - Battle @ CC: PTD (3-2) Forfeit Brangus Glee

BK - Forfeit Lando w/

JM - Battle @ Cantina (14 - 6) Forfeit GMT

BK - Forfeit Luke w/

JM - Scanning Crew (Obi-Wan)

(LS):

BK - Deploy Luke w/ @ Cantina

JM - Broken Concentration to prevent battle.



Turn 12

(DS):

JM - Drain (1)

JM - Deploy U-3PO @ Cantina

JM - Move DV,DLOTS to JP

(LS):

JM - A Dangerous Time (Control Phase)

BK - Deploy Leia w/ @ AC

BK - Battle @ AC (Retwin 'hit')

JM - Retwin hides, ends battle, lose Chief Retwin

BK - Move Luke w/ to JP



Turn 13

(DS):

JM - Deploy Jabba the Hutt @ AC, Deploy Vader's Lightsaber

JM - Battle @ AC (6-4)

BK - Forfeit Luke w/ (Savrip)

JM - Move DV, DLOTS to Cantina

(LS):

BK - Deploy Wedge Antilles @ CC:DPT

BK - Battle @ AC (4-6)

BK - Move Luke w/ to AC

JM - Move U-3PO to JP



Turn 14

(DS):

JM - Drain (3)

(LS):

Turn 15

(DS):

JM - Drain (3)

JM - Move Jabba the Hutt to JP

(LS):

BK - Drain (2)

BK - Move Luke w/ to JP



Turn 16

(DS):

JM - Drain (3)



Josh Martin wins first game by 13 Force.







Game 2

Brett Kitani (DS) vs. Josh Martin (LS)



DS - Started with Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi and Bad Feeling Have I

LS - Started with Hoth: Main Power Generations, Hoth: North Ridge and A New Secret Base



Turn 1

(DS):

BK - Drew up Force

BK - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

(LS):

JM - Deploy Hoth: War Room, Hoth: Corridor, Hoth

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

BK - Lose 1 Force (Visage)



Turn 2

(DS):

BK - Drew Up Force

BK - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

(LS):

JM - Deploy Echo: Docking Bay, Kashyyyk, Do or Do Not, Haven and C. Corvette x2 @ Hoth

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

BK - Lose 1 Force (Visage)



Turn 3

(DS):

BK - Deploy Darth Vader, Dark Lord of the Sith, Vader's Lightsaber @ CC: Port Town District (Flip Objective), Reactor Terminal, CC: Casino

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

(LS):

JM - Drain (1)

JM - Deploy Yavin IV, Arcona @ War Room, Arcona @ Corridor, Wedge @ DB, Red Leader in Red 1, Corvette, and Gold Squardon Y-wing @ Hoth

JM - Move RLinR1 to Kashyyyk, Wedge to Corvette, Corvette x2 to Yavin IV

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)



Turn 4

(DS):

BK - Drain (3)

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)

(LS)

JM - Drain (9)

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)



Turn 5

(DS):

BK - Drain (3)

JM - It Could Be Worse

BK - Sense (Lose 2 Force)

BK - Deploy Commander Igar @ Cloud City Port Town District, Mara Jade with MJ Lightsaber @ CC: Casino, Search and Destroy, Secret Plans, Presence of the Force @ CC: PTD

JM - Lose 1 Force (Search and Destroy)

JM - Lose 1 Force (Visage)



(LS):

JM - Drain (9)

JM - Deploy Bespin, Captain Han in Millennium Falcon @ Hoth

JM - Move MF to Bespin

JM - Lose 1 Force (Search and Destroy, Transmission Terminated to cancel Visage of the Emperor



Turn 6

(DS):

BK - Drain (8)

BK - Deploy Boba Fett in Slave I to Hoth

BK - Battle @ Hoth ('react' with Spiral, 7-26)



Josh Martin wins second game by 9 Force.
